title: Catalog synchronization and exact change following
scope: Initial checkpoint-consistent snapshot followed by retained changes.
proposed_work_bound: Initial scan O(N + descriptor bytes + page lookups); follow-up O(delta events + changed metadata + page lookups), independent of unchanged archived bytes/member inventories.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(page + bounded cursor state) working memory; retention/reaping proportional to expired history.
semantic_requirement: Exact cursor/view/root and access fences, explicit expired/gap errors; no missed changes reported as complete sync.
proposed_witness: Fixed delta against growing unchanged catalog, pagination boundaries, cursor expiry, duplicate notifications and restart.

title: Lifecycle events, cursor stores and relay
scope: Append events, consume new events and retire eligible log history.
proposed_work_bound: O(events appended/delivered + encoded bytes) plus indexed cursor operations; relay O(deliveries*bounded attempt cost), not a full retained-log rewrite per event.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(page/inflight window) RAM; durable state proportional to retention + active delivery checkpoints; remote subscriber delay separately counted.
semantic_requirement: Exact durable sequence and at-least-once/duplicate behavior retained; no false acknowledgment on incomplete delivery.
proposed_witness: Growing retained log with constant new events, slow receivers, reconnect, duplicate delivery and expired cursor; count scanned events and rewritten bytes.

title: Application keys, quotas and usage counters
scope: Read/change exact key/policy/quota records and account one transfer.
proposed_work_bound: O(policy/request bytes + affected counters + log Z); enumerating keys/quotas charged to returned records. No collection-wide byte recount per content chunk or token check.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded transaction/counter state; periodic full reconciliation has its own O(accounting records) declaration.
semantic_requirement: Fresh permission/quota enforcement, exact debit/reservation and idempotent reconciliation retained.
proposed_witness: Grow unrelated collections/keys with one active transfer; count accesses; race reservation, expiry, retry and revocation.

title: Generic workflows, intents and execution claims
scope: Create/progress an exact workflow/claim over an explicit selected input/declared output set.
proposed_work_bound: O(selected N + E + definition bytes + genuine state transitions) plus indexed writes over lifecycle; scalar heartbeat/state/cancel O(p + log Z), not a full plan traversal.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded control documents and transactions; growing input/output/relationship sets paged/spooled.
semantic_requirement: Only owner-authored completed outputs and valid fences settle work; duplicate requests converge without losing exact semantics.
proposed_witness: Grow selection while heartbeat/cancel unchanged; repeated callback, lost receipt, claim refresh/expiry, and source authority mutation.

title: Guarded plans and general collection mutations
scope: Plan or execute a specific copy/description/tag/deletion mutation under guards.
proposed_work_bound: Initial full plan O(affected dependencies + plan bytes); continued bounded step O(delta affected state + log Z). Repeated confirmations cannot re-enumerate everything unless a changed guard actually requires new validation.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: Bounded operation records and step windows; plans may have O(affected set) durable representations.
semantic_requirement: No stale plan or current-permission bypass; distinguish planning cost from bounded status operations.
proposed_witness: Fixed mutation against growing unrelated collection state, stale guard and lost response; count repeated validation versus changed dependencies.

title: Due-work scheduling, status and observability
scope: Choose a bounded due batch, report progress and request cancellation.
proposed_work_bound: O(log Z + due batch p + transition bytes) per scheduling turn; O(D_report) emission. A reported count must use maintained counters/indexes, not traverse all completed members every poll.
proposed_memory_and_state_bound: O(p + configured workers) working state; progress cannot hold payload streams or growing transactions.
semantic_requirement: Correct progress, fencing, fairness and cleanup; workload duration and external waits do not block unrelated jobs.
proposed_witness: Large completed-work history with a tiny ready queue and many polls; count plan decodes, SQL rows and control message bytes; induce a slow independent job.
